identity.name: Sigma Advanced Systems Ltd (formerly Megasoft Ltd)
identity.industry: Defence & Aerospace — A&D Products + Sub-systems + Components (integrated value-chain OEM/supplier)

summary.oneLiner: Sigma is a re-platformed Aerospace & Defence (A&D) integrator (the old listed Megasoft shell now houses a 1994-vintage Indian defence-electronics business plus UK aero-components arm Nasmyth and a European export bridge AS Strategic), pitching itself as a Tier-1 A&D player spanning the value chain from components to integrated products with ~90% defence orderbook, multi-year (up-to-8-year) contracts and a margin-expansion thesis built on transferring UK work to a new Sri City SEZ facility. Q4 FY26 shows headline Total Revenue ~INR 413 cr (but ~INR 91 cr of that is Other Income; operating revenue only ~INR 323 cr) with high reported PBT/PAT margins (32%/31%) — the structural story is inorganic + geographic expansion (Nasmyth Oct-25, AS Strategic Apr-26) into European/NATO and US aerospace supply chains.

one-line thesis: Sigma is a re-platformed Aerospace & Defence (A&D) integrator (the old listed Megasoft shell now houses a 1994-vintage Indian defence-electronics business plus UK aero-components arm Nasmyth and a European export bridge AS Strategic), pitching itself as a Tier-1 A&D player spanning the value chain from components to integrated products with ~90% defence orderbook, multi-year (up-to-8-year) contracts and a margin-expansion thesis built on transferring UK work to a new Sri City SEZ facility. Q4 FY26 shows headline Total Revenue ~INR 413 cr (but ~INR 91 cr of that is Other Income; operating revenue only ~INR 323 cr) with high reported PBT/PAT margins (32%/31%) — the structural story is inorganic + geographic expansion (Nasmyth Oct-25, AS Strategic Apr-26) into European/NATO and US aerospace supply chains.
financial scorecard (track qoq/yoy): > One-offs / distortions: Other Income is ~22% of Q4 Total Revenue and ~38% of FY Total Revenue — headline margins (32% PBT / 31% PAT) are flattered by it; on operating revenue alone the picture differs. Exceptional items INR 1 cr (Q4) / INR 11 cr (FY). Numbers reflect post-reverse-merger consolidated entity incl. recent acquisitions (Nasmyth consolidated from Oct 2025; AS Strategic 51% from Apr 2026 — likely minimal/no FY26 contribution). Not disclosed in deck: segment-wise P&L, prior-year comparatives (no YoY columns), EBITDA bridge.
guidance (critical — verify next quarter: Revenue growth: not quantified in deck. Qualitative — "Core Growth" (deeper penetration of existing platforms/clients + adjacent products) plus "Transformational Growth" (organic + inorganic, geographic + capability expansion).

Margin: qualitative margin-expansion lever = transferring UK work to lower-cost Sri City facility, leveraging Delegatory Approvals to accelerate work-transfer (cited 70%+ reduction in IEC timeframe to 4–6 months). No numeric margin target disclosed.

Order book / inflow target: orderbook value not disclosed. Stated as "long-term contracts up to 8 years"; orderbook split 90% Defence / 10% Commercial; 90%+ international orderbook (per slide 4). Geography revenue split 85% International / 15% India.
Capex / commissioning: new greenfield Sri City SEZ facility (23 acres / ~2.5 lakh sq ft) "coming up"; India FTEs ~300 across Hyderabad & Bangalore by FY27. No commissioning date quantified.
order book & pipeline: Orderbook split: 90% Defence / 10% Commercial; 90%+ international; "long-term contracts up to 8 years."
10+ international export markets. 8 active teaming agreements with global OEMs (via AS Strategic). First-right on workshare in European JVs (AbraWorks, Escrabano/EM&E, Arquimea).
Specific orderbook rupee value, named contracts, and inflow for the quarter: not disclosed in deck.
segment / subsidiary detail: Sigma (parent, founded 1994) — Defence Products & IP: Counter-drone (Anti-Drone Infra for nuclear/oil/ports, Retractor mitigation, military anti-drones, Trooper manpack, Ranger on-the-move); UAVs (long-range loitering munitions, armed UAVs, surveillance drones up to 120 km via Indrajaal); IP (SkyOS threat-visualization, WeaponFusion, HyperMind mission-planning AI). Single-source/dominant share in most programs; 4yr+ vendor-switch cycle; 15–20yr+ platform life.

Sigma — Defence Sub-systems: Missiles (rear servo/actuation, control amplifiers, end-game packages) on LRSAM/MRSAM, INVAR, NGARM, KONKURS; Avionics (flight data recorders, head-down/cockpit displays) on SU-30, HAWK-132, Cheetah/Chetak; Naval (power distribution, display units). Typical revenue split ~50% Missiles / 25% Avionics / 15% Naval / 10% Others. Build-to-spec + build-to-print.

Nasmyth (UK, 100% acquired Oct 2025): Tier-1 supplier of aero-engine hot-section Class-I fabrications & airframe structures; assemblies (heat shields, bearing houses, exhaust casings), complex fabrications, precision machining. Platforms: Trent 700/800/900/1000/XWB, EJ200, Pearl 15/700, TP400, V2500, UltraFan, B787, A320, A350, Eurofighter, F-35, Gripen. Revenue split ~75% Commercial / 25% Defence. 6 UK sites (Bulwell/Nottingham, GEB, Henton/Leicester, Coventry, Ferndown/Bournemouth, IEC), 470+ FTEs, 200k+ sq ft. Delegatory Approvals = unlocks accelerated work-transfer to India.

AS Strategic (51% acquired Apr 2026): European export bridge / strategic supply-chain partner to European & global defence OEMs; direct access to European/UK/NATO programs; 8 teaming agreements; insourcing into Sigma drives margin.
Indrajaal (strategic investment 2023): counter-UAS / autonomous airspace mgmt; Sigma is exclusive supplier of key sub-systems.
growth verticals / optionality: US market expansion (greenfield export market via AS Strategic) — forging capability + treatments cited as complementary build-out.
Work-transfer arbitrage: moving UK (Nasmyth) precision work to Sri City under Delegatory Approvals = the core margin-expansion optionality.
Counter-drone / loitering munitions as a fast-growing defence sub-vertical (Indrajaal linkage).
Aerospace supercycle exposure: deck cites global aerospace market ~2x to USD 846 bn by 2035 (~7.7% CAGR); MRO/space adjacencies.
Indian defence indigenization: 5 positive-indigenization lists (5,012 items, 3,002 done); opportunity in processed materials (Ti, specialty alloys); FY26 India defence budget ~$78.7bn (+9.5% YoY).
margins & cost dynamics: Reported Q4 PBT 32% / PAT 31% — flattered by large Other Income (see §2).
Stated margin lever: in-sourcing within Sigma ecosystem + UK→India work transfer (lower cost base at Sri City SEZ).
COGS ~38% of operating revenue in Q4 (122/323); detailed cost bridge / margin by segment not disclosed.
capex / expansion (watch slippage): New greenfield Sri City SEZ facility: 23 acres, ~2.5 lakh (250k) sq ft, AS9100-aligned QMS, CNC VMC + turning centres, FIFO-traceable controlled stores. "Coming up" — no commissioning date.
India footprint: ~150k sq ft R&D + mfg today (Hyderabad HQ + Bangalore); ~300 India FTEs targeted by FY27.
Global: 300k+ sq ft across 8 locations, 700+ FTEs total. UK 200k+ sq ft / 470+ FTEs across 6 sites.
capital allocation: Aggressive inorganic strategy: Nasmyth (100%, Oct 2025), AS Strategic (51%, Apr 2026), Indrajaal (strategic stake 2023), plus the 2024 reverse-merger into the listed Megasoft shell.

Dedicated President, Corporate Finance & M&A (ex-Goldman Sachs/UBS). Balance sheet: Equity INR 468 cr, total assets INR 1,059 cr; modest interest (INR 11 cr Q4) implies some leverage. Dividend / buyback policy: not disclosed in deck.
risks & watch-items: Other-Income dependence: ~38% of FY Total Revenue is Other Income — headline revenue/margins overstate operating quality; watch what this comprises.
Acquisition integration: rapid roll-up (Nasmyth UK, AS Strategic, Indrajaal) + reverse-merger — integration, goodwill, and minority (49% JV / 49% AS Strategic) risks.
Disclosure quality (deck): no YoY comparatives, no segment P&L, no orderbook rupee value, no explicit guidance — typical of a corporate presentation, not a concall.
Customer/program concentration: single-source on many programs (a strength and a concentration risk); ~90% defence orderbook ties revenue to MoD/PSU procurement cycles.
FX / cross-border: UK + European + US operations introduce GBP/EUR/USD exposure; tariff/export-control risk on NATO/defence work.
Stale public classification: still tagged as a telecom (Megasoft) name in metadata — index/screen mis-tagging risk.
management quality / tone: Cannot assess call tone (no concall). Deck is professionally produced (Go India Advisors IR). Heavyweight defence-credentialed board (ex-Vice Chief of Army Staff, retired Ambassador) and operators with Nasmyth/Gardner Aerospace pedigree (John Rooney) — signals genuine A&D depth. Presentation is somewhat promotional ("Tier-1 global player," "building India's leading Defence & Aerospace company") and leans on headline Total-Revenue including Other Income.
non-obvious takeaways: The "₹413 Cr Revenue (Q4 FY26)" hero number on slide 4 includes ~INR 91 cr Other Income; true operating revenue is INR 323 cr (Q4) / INR 492 cr (FY) — the single most important adjustment for anyone modelling this name.

This is functionally a brand-new listed A&D vehicle wearing an old telecom (Megasoft) listing — screeners, indices and metadata still mis-classify it as Telecom; the real comparable set is defence-electronics / aero-components names.

The differentiated asset is Nasmyth's Delegatory Approvals, which let Sigma legally fast-track transfer of UK aero-engine/airframe work to its low-cost Sri City SEZ — the crux of the margin-expansion thesis (verify execution next quarter).
~90% international orderbook + 85% international revenue makes this an unusually export-tilted Indian defence name (most peers are domestic-MoD-led).

Balance sheet INR 1,059 cr (equity 468). Orderbook 90% defence / 90%+ international, contracts up to 8 yrs (value not disclosed). themes.title: Defence indigenization & order-book visibility
themes.need: Indigenization mandates (IDDM / Atmanirbhar / DcPP) plus multi-year order books make domestic defence the cleanest revenue-conversion theme - across electronics, drones, simulators, explosives/munitions and precision systems. BEL guides >INR55k cr FY27 inflow (~INR30k cr QRSAM pending CCS clearance, guided by September) on a INR72,258cr order book; HAL book ~INR2.55 lakh cr; SOLARINDS defence revenue +94% to INR2,634cr FY26, guided >INR4,500cr FY27 on an ~INR18,000cr defence order book (Bhargavastra counter-drone trials completing CY2026); DATAPATTNS inflows strong; BHARATFORG/BEML add land-systems and platforms.
themes.driver: Backlog-to-revenue conversion underway; BEL's QRSAM CCS clearance (guided by Sep-2026, ~INR30k cr of the FY27 inflow guide) is the load-bearing near-term catalyst; fresh MoD orders + emergency procurement; HAL LCA Mk-1A ramp (gated on GE engines).
